1. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __distinct__ carboxylated inulin; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures __not exceeding__ about 280 *F.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about __substantially__ constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is __explicitly__ not added to the cement composition.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of __the total weight of__ the cement composition.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or __greater__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin that has been __treated in a specific manner__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of __said carboxylated inulin__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or __additional additives__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation __structured to retain said composition__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __for sealing or stabilizing purposes__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __selected__ carboxylated inulin; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures __not exceeding__ about 280 *F.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about __substantially__ constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a suspension aid is __explicitly__ not added to the cement composition.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of __the total weight of__ the cement composition.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or __greater__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin that has been __treated in a specific manner__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of __said carboxylated inulin__.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or __additional additives__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __for sealing or stabilizing purposes__.
